current_evidence: The council's 'apply for planning permission' page links this PDF as its 'Validation guidance document (PDF, 1.86MB)'. The document gives no adoption or publication date, saying only 'correct at the date of publication'.

issues.detail: List date 2026-07-01 comes only from the upload folder in the URL. Neither the document nor the linking page states a publication or adoption date, so the date should be marked as unverified or URL-derived rather than given as the list date.
issues.evidence: 'All information contained in this document is correct at the date of publication' (no date given)

issues.detail: None of the 14 tab_items is a validation requirement. They are drawing-standard notes, links to the invalid-applications page, an email/postal submission address (plservices@eastcambs.gov.uk, The Grange, Nutholt Lane), notes on fee refunds, pointers to the CIL webpage and SPDs, parking Table 7.1 references and page-navigation fragments ('Back to previous page Main contents P 10 P 11').
issues.evidence: tab_items section 'Submission rules': 'If you are unable to use this service we can also accept email submissions to plservices@eastcambs.gov.uk...'

issues.detail: These Section 4 local requirements have no row of their own: Green Belt Statement (any application in the Green Belt at Bottisham, Lode or Swaffham Bulbeck); Retail and Town Centre Uses statement (main town centre uses outside centres, with an Impact Assessment above 280 sq m); Wildlife Hazard Risk Assessment (development within 13km of an aerodrome likely to attract hazardous birds); Utilities Statement (10+ dwellings or 1,000 sq m+ commercial); Arboricultural Method Statement (where the design is likely to significantly affect retained trees, BS 5837); Parking/Servicing Details (10+ dwellings or 1,000 sq m+, changed parking or access, or a change of use that intensifies parking).
issues.evidence: Validation guidance Section 4: 'Green Belt Statement - Only required for the following: ...'; 'Wildlife Hazard Risk Assessment'; 'Retail and Town Centre Uses'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only'. The list's local triggers do reach householder schemes: Flood Risk Assessment (every application in Flood Zones 2, 3 or 3b), Heritage Statement (listed buildings or Conservation Areas), Tree Survey/AIA (trees on or next to the site), ecology (where protected species or habitats may be affected), Local BNG ('Required for every application') and the CIL Form 1 (extensions creating 100 sq m+).
issues.evidence: 'Flood Risk Assessment - every application in Flood Zones 2, 3 or 3b including minor development and change of use'; 'Local Biodiversity Net Gain - Required for every application'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts belong to the neighbouring requirement because the two-column layout bled together. Structural Survey shows the Statement of Community Involvement trigger ('in excess of 50 dwellings or 1000 sq m'); its real trigger is substantial demolition or alteration of a listed building, demolition in a Conservation Area, or conversion. Noise Impact Assessment shows the Lighting trigger ('major applications which are likely to have a visual impact'). Air Quality shows the Local BNG text ('Required for every application'). Design and Access Statement and Fire Statement show fee and drawings text.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Structural Survey: 'Community Involvement Structural Survey Only required for the following ... in excess of 50 dwellings or 1000'

issues.detail: Many triggers are page-navigation junk or sentences cut off before the threshold. Examples: Contaminated Land ('and possible land contamination test will be needed...'), Foul Sewage ('As with foul drainage... Building Regulations'; real trigger: new sewage system, 10+ dwellings, 1,000 sq m or 0.5ha), Water efficiency ('Only required for the following: Policy drivers'; real trigger: 1,000 sq m+ buildings, 5+ dwellings, 0.5ha+ residential, 1ha+ any), Ecological Survey ('Section 3 - National Requirements P 26 P 27 Application form'), Block plan, Floor plans.
issues.evidence: Renewable Energy and Water Consumption Assessment: '1,000 sq m+ gross external... residential 5+ units... 0.5ha+'

issues.detail: Placement errors. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' sits under Outline, and its excerpt is about arboricultural method statements. Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment sits under Listed building consent, but the source applies it to majors with significant visual impact and all EIA. CIL form sits under Outline and Reserved matters only, though the source applies it to any new dwelling or 100 sq m+ extension. Flood Risk Assessment is the only item under prior approval, and Structural Survey (which names prior-approval conversions) is not there.
issues.evidence: 'Structural Survey - ... conversion or restoration (including prior approval)'

issues.detail: About 37 requirements are placed under Full planning, many flagged 'INFERRED: application type not named', even where the source sets a size threshold. Examples: Statement of Community Involvement (over 50 dwellings or 1,000 sq m only), Affordable Housing (10+ dwellings), Utilities and Refuse (new dwellings or commercial). The source does not split by application type; it uses thresholds, so Full planning is over-inclusive.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows notes 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text...'

issues.detail: Statutory national items such as Mandatory BNG (statutory small-site metric), Fire Statement, application form, drawings and Design and Access Statement are mixed in with the local requirements. The document puts these in Section 3 (National Requirements), separate from the Section 4 local list.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current validation guidance. However, its tab items are all process text, and its app-type rows have misaligned or garbled triggers. Several local requirements are missing (Green Belt Statement, Retail/Town Centre, Wildlife Hazard, Utilities, Arboricultural Method Statement, Parking), and Householder is wrongly marked as having no local requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
